name: Hex
title: Hex: free Wispr Flow alternative
hook: Wispr Flow Pro charges you fifteen dollars a month to type whatever you say. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Hold a key, talk, and it types.
features.say: Hold the shortcut and speak. When you let go, the text lands at your cursor, in any app.
It cuts the ums and fixes names your way, with different rules for each app.

caption:
Wispr Flow Pro charges $15/month to type whatever you say. Hex does it for free 🎙️

✅ Hold a shortcut, talk, and the text pastes at your cursor in any app
✅ Cuts the ums and fixes names, with different rules per app
✅ Transcribes on your device with a local speech model
✅ No subscription, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The Mac build is for Apple silicon, Windows and Linux are still in beta, and Hex downloads a speech model on first run. (Wispr Flow has a limited free plan; $15/month is Pro, unlimited)

Comment "VOICE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
